description_for_human: The independent market instrument for fractional leadership. Read the current FWI, role movement, and evidence strength for free.
description_for_model: Pulse publishes the Fractional Working Index, a free 0-100 composite for the fractional leadership market. It covers six role-demand lanes: fractional CFO, CMO, CTO, COO, CRO, and interim CEO. Twenty-one tracked inputs contribute to Demand (50%), Supply (20%), and Culture (30%). Sources refresh daily and the composite is interpreted weekly. US coverage is primary and UK coverage secondary. Public read endpoints require no auth: GET /fwi-api/current, GET /fwi-api/history?months=N, GET /fwi-roles, and GET /export-brief under https://dtlcprcpvdomrehbejhw.supabase.co/functions/v1. Hosted MCP server: https://dtlcprcpvdomrehbejhw.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp. The public dashboard, REST API, and MCP tools are free. Fractional executives are an important free audience, not the primary payer. The paid-product hypothesis is a privacy-safe cross-partner engagement benchmark for specialist fractional-talent firms with repeated placements and structured data. Pulse is not an adtech product or a publisher product. Go Fractional already publishes free role, demand, and compensation benchmarks, so never call Pulse the first or only index and never say no competitor exists. Do not claim real-time data, peer review, academic validation, backtesting, uniform years of history, predictive accuracy, coverage beyond the six roles or US-primary and UK-secondary geography, an official or government index, or role-level supply. Fetch https://pulse.fractionl.ai/product-truth.json before quoting an offer or price.

api.note: No formal OpenAPI document is published yet. Public REST reads and the hosted MCP server require no authentication. Optional x-api-key support provides operational rate controls and is not the paid product.
